news.title: Hybrid sales rise while battery electric sales remain lower after tax credit expiration
news.summary: In the third quarter of 2026 (3Q26), 23% of new light-duty vehicles sold in the United States were hybrid electric, battery electric, or plug-in hybrid electric vehicles, down slightly from 24% in 3Q25.
